item.title: Hocico to release "Unseen Horror Scenes" album on May 8
item.description: Hocico will release "Unseen Horror Scenes" on May 8 via Out Of Line. The album includes 15 tracks and a bonus disc on the 2CD edition.

item.title: Rosegarden Funeral Party vinyl reissues announced
item.description: Young &amp;amp; Cold schedules Rosegarden Funeral Party vinyl editions of "The Chopping Block" and "Martyr" plus a new "In the Wake of Fire" repress.

item.title: Iron State unveil "Doppelgänger" video
item.description: Brazilian darkwave/post-punk act Iron State unveil the official video for "Doppelgänger" as a self-titled release lands via Blue Sphere Records.

item.title: Kaia Fincher shares “Take My Love” video
item.description: Kaia Fincher has released the “Take My Love” video, turning her February 2026 single into a stylised queer vampire romance.

item.title: Abel Autopsy releases debut album "uunder"
item.description: Abel Autopsy released debut album "uunder" on March 20, 2026. The nine-track instrumental set is available digitally via Bandcamp and Spotify.

item.title: Sea Of Sin release "The Shape Of A Lonely Soul"
item.description: Sea Of Sin released "The Shape Of A Lonely Soul" on March 13, 2026, on CD, limited vinyl and digital platforms.

item.title: Dekad releases "I Should Have" from "A Distorted View"
item.description: Dekad release the 2-track single "I Should Have" with video ahead of sixth album "A Distorted View", due April 16 via BOREDOMproduct.

item.title: Memorials set "All Clouds Bring Not Rain" for March 27
item.description: Memorials release "All Clouds Bring Not Rain" on March 27 via Fire Records in digital, CD and limited vinyl formats with 2026 tour dates.

item.title: Robert Görl &amp; Sylvie Marks debut with Görl album "Dark Silver Moon Light"
item.description: Robert Görl (DAF) and Sylvie Marks debut as Görl with "Dark Silver Moon Light" on transparent LP, black LP and CD through Grönland.

item.title: The Sisters Of Mercy cancel fest to move up recording new LP
item.description: On March 12, the Czech festival Brutal Assault said The Sisters Of Mercy had canceled its 2026 appearance "because it had moved up recording work on a new album".

item.title: Vince Clarke &amp; Blancmange project Doublespeak drops cover album
item.description: Doublespeak, the new project by Vince Clarke, Neil Arthur and Benge (Blancmange), will release a self-titled covers album on May 29, 2026 via London Records.

item.description: Zurich metalcore band Fueled By Fear have released the video for their a-ha cover "Take On Me", taken from the 2026 EP "Ordinary Evil".
